name: Kiel

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Kiel Digital Stadtgrundkarte page loaded; it states the map combines ALKIS with municipal topography and includes parcels, and its current map link points to the city-hosted Kiel maps service.

Official city-hosted parcel layer metadata loaded. Layer 196 is a polygon Feature Layer named Flurstuecke eigen, lists FLSTKENNZ and SHAPE, advertises JSON/GeoJSON query formats, and declares spatial reference WKID 4647/display 102362.
Anonymous feature query rejected by the service; no geometry or identity response. Treated as an unavailable/failed route, not parcel absence.
Alternate official city parcel layer envelope query rejected; no geometry or identity response.
Alternate official city-hosted parcel layer metadata loaded; layer 11 is polygon Flurstücke with FLSTKENNZ and SHAPE and the same displayed spatial reference.
Anonymous alternate-layer attribute query rejected; no feature response.
Official Kiel service page confirms cadastral map extracts are provided by LVermGeo SH or qualifying municipal authorities and describes public parcel-map content.
Official Kiel service page identifies LVermGeo SH as the cadastral authority for Liegenschaftskataster access and describes public cadastral contents; owner details were not requested.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: WKID 4647 (ETRS89 / UTM 32N), displayed by ArcGIS metadata as 102362.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Not applicable; no feature was returned and no composite identity was inferred.

qualification.reason: Official municipal parcel-layer metadata is verified, but no anonymous bounded feature response was returned; independent serial review is required before adapter qualification or admission.
